description: Bus Stops is a series of datasets listed in UK national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Plymouth City Council. Data showing geographic locations of all bus stops within the Plymouth boundary. Coverage: Plymouth City Council. The portal lists 4 near-identical datasets in this series (one per year, month, area or site), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher Plymouth City Council. Its tags are Getting around. It offers 2 resource(s) in CSV, GEOJSON. The portal shows 2025-03-02 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is UK Open Government Licence (OGL). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-uk-portal.
